why: The Cytech Factory is a quest-only industrial interior in Arroyo, used by Muamar Reyes' gig 'Severance Package' (break in, reach the server room, steal ex-engineer Rihanna Kumar's research). In vanilla it is empty until the gig starts and the street-story prefab loads. This proposal loads the street-story prefab and switches on the factory's own population - Cytech private security at their posts, line workers at machines, and four utility droids - in their relaxed initial phases.

open_questions: Walk in through the main door on Olivia St. and confirm the factory interior loads and the door opens.
Confirm the Cytech security guards are calm at their posts (patrolling, leaning, smoking), not crouched or sheltering.
Confirm the three workers and four droids are visible at the machines on the ground floor and second floor.
Check whether the private security turns hostile when you walk in; note it in the checklist if they do.
Visit the factory at night and confirm the staff still spawn (all their community spots are authored with the Day time period).

communities.why: The factory's own crowd: ten Cytech private-security guards plus three line workers, exactly as vanilla switches them on at gig start. The whole-community activation uses each entry's initial phase (A_spawn or A), whose spots are patrol, stand-around, lean-and-smoke, barstool-sleep and work-table workspots - relaxed posts, not alert. The catalogue has posture unknown only because its spot map was missing; the spot nodes are in the venue sectors and were resolved by hand.

Four utility droids on the factory floor, vanilla's whole-community activation in phase A. Their spots are stand-and-use-tablet workspots among the machinery; harmless and appropriate for a plant that is not under attack.

proximity_wait.why: The factory's front door on the normal route in, and the first device the player passes; a DoorControllerPS, not a workspot. The venue declares no anchor candidates of its own and the main door is the natural arrival point (the #arr_10_tr_enter and #arr_10_tr_start triggers sit just outside at approx. -706,-1387).
